displayTitle: Millennium Falcon Deluxe Book and Model Set
synopsis: Star Wars: Millennium Falcon Deluxe Book and Model Set is a Millennium Falcon model kit published by Insight Editions as part of their IncrediBuilds collection. The kit includes a laser-cut, FSC-certified wood sheet, step-by-step instructions, coloring and crafting ideas, and a Millennium Falcon guidebook, titled Inside the Fastest Hunk of Junk in the Galaxy, written by Michael Kogge
title: Millennium Falcon Deluxe Book and Model Set
